title: Remote connections
goal: Connect with SSH and move files using SFTP.
note: The report contains five embedded connection/transfer screenshots. Screenshots may identify accounts and are kept out of the public package.

title: Linux commands and vi
goal: Compose commands, redirect output, filter a stream, and edit a text file.
note: The documents combine command tasks, screenshot answers and typed vi answers. The mock editor is a small teaching interface, not a complete vi implementation.

title: Inodes and permissions
goal: Watch two names share an inode while a symbolic link stores a path.
note: The submitted document contains ten embedded images. The model uses invented inode IDs and logical timestamps to explain link counts and access checks.

title: Git basics
goal: Follow a file through working tree, index, and commit.
note: Screenshot-based Git exercises are reconstructed in memory. No real repository is changed.

title: Branches and merging
goal: Create a feature branch and inspect a simulated merge.
note: The brief also asks for conflicting blue/green edits and accepting both changes. The mock supports conflict markers and explicit re-staging; its merge model is bounded to small text snapshots.

title: Remote Git workflow
goal: Inspect local commits and a simulated remote snapshot.
note: The original task includes account setup and SSH keys. This showcase uses fictional remote state; it never requests credentials or creates keys.

title: C decisions and parity
goal: Find the smallest even and odd values in four inputs.
note: The source uses nested decisions. The brief incorrectly calls zero neither odd nor even; mathematically zero is even, while this exercise explicitly excludes it. New validation follows the brief’s two-even/two-odd, nonzero input assumptions.

title: Functions and menu programs
goal: Break a vending and loan menu into separate functions.
note: Original change logic uses fractional quarters, accepts prices outside five-cent increments, and selection does not return a value on every path. The browser model implements the intended exercise with added validation.

title: Shared and static libraries
goal: Compile two units, build a library, and inspect the linking route.
note: Original source was actually built into both static and shared executables during review. Both produce hypotenuse 5 and area 6 for sides 3/4. Browser build steps and executable output are simulations of that tested fixture.

title: Pointers and indirection
goal: Follow c → b → a and change a through a double pointer.
note: The original helper does not compile and mixes incompatible types, invalid text and unsafe pointer movement. The model demonstrates valid indirection and symbolic locations; it does not reproduce invalid pointer expressions.

title: Passing pointer levels
goal: Pass a value, its address, and increasingly indirect references.
note: The compiler accepts this source with incompatible-pointer diagnostics around void *** d and the final function call. Compilation is not proof of portable correctness.

title: Void pointers and casts
goal: Recover a typed object through a void pointer.
note: The original uses void *** where the brief asks for void *, then performs incompatible assignments and pointer/integer formatting. The browser shows a valid conceptual void-pointer access only.

title: Arrays and pointer arithmetic
goal: Distinguish an array element from its address.
note: The original has pointer/integer conversion and return-type warnings. The model illustrates valid array[i] and *(array+i), with no fabricated real addresses.

title: Arrays and makefiles
goal: Store up to five menu operations and separate compilation units.
note: The split program increments the count before indexing, can write row 5, stores a running vending total, and display.c is a placeholder. The updated variant also passes incompatible pointers. The new ledger follows the intended five-row brief, not verified original runtime behavior.

title: Swapping strings and pointers
goal: Swap references, then swap the contents of original buffers.
note: Original source compiles without diagnostics in this check; unbounded scanf/strcpy require short inputs. The browser bounds strings to nine ASCII letters and labels buffer IDs.

title: Tokenizing strings
goal: Inspect separator characters and the tokens they define.
note: The original calls gets, uses fflush(stdin), risks overflowing rows, and reuses a buffer already modified by strtok before strstr. The new tokenizer is a bounded explanation and does not certify the original three methods as equivalent.

title: Structures and heap allocation
goal: Connect nested records to dynamically allocated character storage.
note: assign17.c allocates only one byte for a school name and scans an unbounded string. The related heap exercise shows a pointer table and cleanup but needs input/buffer checks. The model uses fictional student labels, never real identity numbers.

title: Final project: threads and processes
goal: Follow pthread_create, fork, exec, wait and join in the submitted program.
note: The original joins t1 before creating t2. The submitted university screenshot shows the combined name, a ps listing and child status 0. A controlled local retest returned ps status 1. execlp lacks a proper argv[0], waitpid receives NULL instead of integer 0, and error/status checks are incomplete. The visual trace distinguishes intended success from this observed nonzero result.
